## 中文

### 变更描述

请清晰地描述你做了什么变更。

### 相关 Issue

- Closes # (issue number)
- Related to # (issue number)

### 变更类型

- [ ] Bug 修复
- [ ] 新功能
- [ ] 文档更新
- [ ] 样式/格式调整
- [ ] 重构
- [ ] 其他（请说明）

### 测试情况

- [ ] 我已经测试了这些更改
- [ ] 这些更改需要更新文档

### 检查清单

- [ ] 我的代码遵循项目的代码规范
- [ ] 我已经阅读了 [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] 中英文文档已同步更新（如适用）

---

## English

### Description

Please clearly describe what changes you've made.

### Related Issues

- Closes # (issue number)
- Related to # (issue number)

### Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Style/formatting
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Other (please describe)

### Testing

- [ ] I have tested these changes
- [ ] These changes require documentation updates

### Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's code standards
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Both Chinese and English docs are synced (if applicable)
